source.archive: NASA MAAP HLS STAC GeoParquet archive (Iceberg table)

array.plot_scaling: Stored int16 digital numbers (DN); montage display clips DN to 0-2000. No physical reflectance scale is asserted.

coverage.interpretation: Year-unioned STAC item geometries represented by one footprint per MGRS tile. coverage.svg uses an equal-degree equirectangular Americas overview; selection.svg uses an equal-metre EPSG:32615 inset. Footprints are not cloud-free pixel coverage.

source_grid_sample.raster_bands_scale_unit_metadata: Not declared in this current STAC asset; physical reflectance scale/unit not asserted.

authentication: Existing local Earthdata HTTPS flow succeeded for bounded authenticated HLS COG reads. No credentials or authorization headers were printed or persisted. Public metadata objects were fetched by unsigned HTTPS; no AWS credential discovery or S3 pixel access was used.
checks: Latest Iceberg metadata pointer and Avro manifests returned HTTP 200; exact current unpadded January 2025 object returned HTTP 200.
Initial guessed zero-padded January probe returned HTTP 403 (the notebook generates unpadded months); public bucket listing returned HTTP 403.
All 12 manifest-listed 2025 HLSS30_2.0 parquet partitions downloaded and validated: 2,715,469 records, 665,392,268 compressed bytes.
Current authenticated HTTPS HLS COG HEAD returned HTTP 200; baseline and selected 5 km pixel captures completed.
Baseline daily array and separate monthly eo:cloud_cover-filtered array opened; monthly time coordinate count is 12.
Current scene metadata query found 77 candidates under eo:cloud_cover < 30; montage plan is 9 chunk reads / 15 COG reads.

Footprint query excludes assets, links, and other bulky fields; 23,490 item records reduce to 302 unique MGRS tile footprints. Maps show an equirectangular Americas overview and an equal-metre EPSG:32615 inset.

Current point SVG markers were added at the 45 retained saved-path vertices (15 per band); no pixel data was reread and no new coordinates were inferred. The original plot line paths are simplified, so these markers do not reconstruct all 123 valid raw observations.
caveats: Direct HLS S3 pixel access requires compute in AWS us-west-2; use HTTPS elsewhere.
The dense-array logical size is not a claim about transfer size or peak memory.
eo:cloud_cover is scene-level metadata, not a pixel cloud mask.
Plots display raw stored DNs, not reflectance-scaled values; no physical reflectance units are claimed.
